general.title: General
general.description: Control how your financial data is calculated and displayed across the app.

creditLimit.label: Include credit limits in balance
creditLimit.description: When enabled, credit limits are subtracted from account balances in statistics and the balance trend chart. This shows your actual financial position instead of available credit.

manualTransferMatching.label: Match transfers with manual accounts
manualTransferMatching.description: Allow automatically detected transfers to link a synced bank transaction with one you created manually.
manualTransferMatching.errorNotification: Failed to update transfer matching setting

savingsCategories.label: Count categories as savings
savingsCategories.description: Spending in these categories (and their subcategories) is excluded from expenses in cash-flow analytics, so it counts toward monthly savings and the savings rate.

defaultAccount.label: Default account
defaultAccount.description: Pre-selected when you create a transaction.

showArchived.label: Show archived accounts
showArchived.description: When off, archived accounts are hidden from account pickers.

accountDropdowns.errorNotification: Failed to update account dropdown settings

showUpcomingTransactions.label: Show upcoming transactions
showUpcomingTransactions.description: Pin a section with overdue scheduled payments and ones due within the next 3 days at the top of the transactions list.
showUpcomingTransactions.errorNotification: Failed to update upcoming transactions setting

transactionFields.label: Optional transaction fields
transactionFields.description: Extra fields shown in the transaction form. A field that already has a value is always shown.
transactionFields.errorNotification: Unexpected error happened. Setting not saved

externalUrl.label: External URL
externalUrl.description: Link the transaction to an order page, booking confirmation or receipt.

externalReference.label: External reference
externalReference.description: Keep an order number, invoice number or booking reference with the transaction.

originalAmount.label: Original amount
originalAmount.description: The amount actually charged in another currency, when it differs from the account's currency.

location.label: Location
location.description: GPS coordinates of where the purchase happened. Fill from your device's location or type them in

mapPicker.label: Map picker
mapPicker.description: Pick transaction locations on a map and search addresses. Map tiles and search come from OpenStreetMap, which receives your IP address when the map opens.
